title: Tw-fade: pure CSS scroll-driven edge masking
originalTitle: Tw-fade: pure CSS scroll-driven edge masking
content:
Plugin for Tailwind CSS v4

Elegant, scroll-driven edge masking. One class. Zero JavaScript.

npm i tw-fade

Horizontal fade-x

Vertical fade-y

hey! finally trying tw-fade 👋

oh nice — welcome

these scroll lists are slick

thanks, it’s all CSS

this thread fades at the edges while i scroll 👀

that’s tw-fade ✨

some scroll library?

nope — a pure CSS mask

zero JavaScript

so how does it know i’m scrolling?

scroll-driven CSS — the fade is scroll-gated

does it soften both edges?

fade-y — one class on the container

but the newest message stays sharp 🔥

pinned to the bottom, yep — scroll up and both edges dissolve ↕︎
